description.value: Viewpoint Beach is a boat-in or walk-in campground on Alouette Lake within Golden Ears Park, offering a quiet lakeshore setting in one of BC's premier parks; hard non-road access makes it effectively unreachable for loaded touring cyclists.

raw_osm.name: Viewpoint Beach Campground
raw_osm.note: Not mapped as an area because camping is dispersed and there is no designated pitches..

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Viewpoint Beach Campground as a basic dispersed backcountry campsite inside Golden Ears Provincial Park, operated by BC Parks; OSM amenity tags (drinking_water=no, shower=no, power_supply=no, reservation=no, tents=yes, toilets=yes) are the primary evidence source since the fetched website covers all of Golden Ears Park and does not mention Viewpoint Beach Campground by name. OSM negative tags are accepted as confirmed false for applicable amenities; all other amenities unaddressed by OSM or the website are marked null.
concerns: The linked website covers all of Golden Ears Park and does not mention Viewpoint Beach Campground by name; all campground-specific amenity data relies solely on OSM tags.
No potable water on-site (OSM: drinking_water=no); touring cyclists must carry or treat water.
No address or named access route available beyond lat/lon coordinates, which may make wayfinding difficult.
OSM note states camping is fully dispersed with no designated pitches, which could make the site hard to locate without supplemental route guidance.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate BC Parks backcountry campsite, but it is extremely basic (no water, no reservations, fully dispersed) and the park website does not specifically describe or confirm Viewpoint Beach Campground; a directory reviewer should confirm whether the site is practically accessible and useful for touring cyclists.
